agents.name: 📝 Qualidade de Código
agents.prompt: This is a code review for a frontend React pull request. Focus on React patterns, hooks usage, TypeScript typing, component composition, naming conventions and code readability.

agents.name: 🏗️ Arquitetura
agents.prompt: This is an architecture review for a frontend React pull request. Focus on Feature-Sliced Design compliance, import rules, layer boundaries, shared module usage and coupling between features.

agents.name: ♿ Acessibilidade
agents.prompt: This is an accessibility review for a frontend React pull request. Focus on WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, ARIA attributes, keyboard navigation, focus management, semantic HTML and color contrast. If no UI components were changed, confirm that briefly.

agents.name: ⚡ Performance
agents.prompt: This is a performance review for a frontend React pull request. Focus on unnecessary re-renders, missing memoization, bundle size impact, lazy loading opportunities, data fetching patterns and rendering optimizations.
